description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Rikku)] and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Rikku)
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 2 additional times, causes [Imperil Water 10% (15s)] and [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES -40% (8s)] after using two Water abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [50% Critical (25s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Rikku)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Rikku)] from the user
